proposed_abilities.description: Construct or validate one bounded provider-neutral EVM observation-evidence record without observing a provider or changing state.
Describe one explicit semantic relation between exact evidence digests without applying the transition.
Project one exact atomic quantity into unregistered Math Cards-shaped measurement vocabulary without operating an instrument or asserting truth.

notes: This descriptor is a declaration-only KINGDOM hint and is not an installed or registered host contract.
It proposes only the package's pure evidence, receipt, and measurement projections. It does not register or grant access to the separate injected-transport Alchemy read client.

A host-injected read transport may perform a separately authorized provider read, but package or descriptor presence grants no network, credential, provider, wallet, database, publication, or action authority.

Evidence digests are private linkable metadata and prove neither privacy nor truth. Provider assertions do not become chain consensus, finality, identity, consent, custody, rights status, permission, or authority.
